mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in housing starts signals a robust demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong housing starts (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% triggers a tightening monetary cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of high federal funds rates (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate above 5% signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of high unemployment rates (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production signals a weakening supply environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of weak industrial production (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between strong housing starts and rising consumer prices signals a robust demand environment with potential inflationary pressures, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong housing starts and rising consumer prices (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between a rising federal funds rate and a strong labor market signals a tightening monetary cycle with potential labor market constraints, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of high federal funds rates and low unemployment rates (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in payroll employment signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of weak payroll employment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between strong retail sales and rising consumer prices signals a robust demand environment with potential inflationary pressures, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong retail sales and rising consumer prices (t-test p > 0.05).
